about: What tools/types.mjs builds each type's page from (examples/types/<type>.json and .html): for each type (the map and docs/types.md's 28), its page's title and its variants, in card order. A variant source is an example of examples/ ("sales-classes" is examples/sales-classes.json) or a variant file ("variants/uml-class-down" is examples/variants/uml-class-down.json, named <type>-<name>); each of its views of the type gets a card on the page's overview: its sub (a short line on the card) and its text (what the view shows, in the card's details). Plain keyboard characters; `code` in backticks.

shapes.text: A card of each kind that has a shape, in the one style maps draw: people, a browser app, a phone, a window (a card's own `shape`), a terminal, an agent, a database, a queue, a file, a module, hosts, a hook and an external system.

boxed.text: A map generated from a dependency list by `monorepo.py`: a card per package, a line per import, heavier with more imports, a box per folder, nested as the folders are.

plain.text: The same packages and imports as the boxed view, with no boxes: the layout without folders.

domain.text: Compartments of attributes and operations, an interface, an enumeration and a data type, composition and aggregation, generalization, realization, a `<<use>>` dependency and a note, each end with its role and multiplicity.

payments-only.text: Four classes of the sales domain named plainly from the view's `subject`, Order with its compartments collapsed, laid out down.

members.text: Every member notation: the four visibilities (+ - # ~), a static attribute and operation underlined, a derived attribute, defaults and multiplicities, parameters with their direction, an abstract class and operation in italics, a primitive type and a data type, and a class cut to 3 rows then "+k more".

lines.text: Every kind of line a class view draws: an association navigable both ways, roles and multiplicities, composite and shared aggregation, an interface realization, a usage, an abstraction, a plain dependency with a name and a comment link, listed in the view's `edges`.

right.text: An abstract class with four specializations and two interfaces, laid out right (the default direction): generalizations and realizations as hollow triangles, an enumeration used by an interface.

down.text: The same hierarchy with `direction: "down"`: the general class above its specializations, the interfaces beside it and each class's place pinned in `layout`.

snapshot.text: Instances of the bookshop's classes, each head `name : Classifier` underlined, slots as `feature = value`, and links with a name or roles by their ends.

packages.text: Packages as boxes holding what they own, a package inside a package, two classes named Order in two packages, `<<import>>`, `<<access>>`, `<<merge>>` and a dependency between them, and a profile applied by `<<apply>>`.

internals.text: A class's parts and ports, a part showing its type's ports, connectors through parts, open collaborations and collaboration uses with their role bindings.

components.text: Components nested in components, ports on their borders, delegations inward, assembly connectors, provided and required interfaces as a ball and socket, artifacts and their manifestations.

production.text: Nodes, devices and execution environments as cubes, nested; artifacts deployed by nesting or by a `<<deploy>>` line; deployment specifications and communication paths.

profile.text: Stereotypes with tag definitions extending metaclasses, a required extension, a profile applied to a package, and an element's tags in a compartment per stereotype; stereotypes applied anywhere in the model are checked against it.

shopping.text: Actors as stick figures, use cases as ellipses with their extension points, the subject as a box holding them, and include, extend and generalization between them.

fulfil.text: Actions, object nodes and a data store, send and accept actions, decisions, merges, forks and joins, in lanes; a call behaviour action opens the activity it calls.

take-payment.text: The activity the call behaviour action Take payment calls: its own actions and flows, opened from the fulfilling activity.

order-life.text: States with their activities, composite states as boxes with orthogonal regions, a choice, a fork and a join, a shallow history and a terminate, and transitions written `trigger [guard] / effect`.

checkout-sequence.text: Lifelines on a time axis, calls, a self-call, async messages, replies and a create, activation bars derived from the messages, `alt` and `opt` frames with their guards, and an interaction use.

find-book.text: The sequence view the interaction overview's use Find a book opens: a short exchange between lifelines.

buy-checkout.text: The sequence view the interaction overview's use Check out opens.

email-receipt.text: The sequence view the interaction overview's use Email the receipt opens.

queue-order.text: The sequence view the interaction overview's inline interaction Queue the order shows.

checkout-communication.text: The checkout's paid branch as lifelines joined by connectors, each link's messages a stack of numbered rows with an arrow toward the receiver.

buy-book.text: Interaction uses and an inline interaction drawn with its sequence diagram inside, joined by the activity's control nodes and flows; each use, and the inline interaction, opens its sequence view.

one-charge.text: Lifelines on one linear time ruler, each a step line through its states or a band of values, messages at their times, duration and time constraints.

order-flows.text: Information items, and dashed `<<flow>>` lines between classifiers and actors, each saying what it conveys.

requirements.text: Requirements with their id and text in a frame with SysML's header; containment drawn with a crosshair; derive, satisfy, verify, refine, trace and copy, each checked as SysML says.

blocks.text: Blocks, interface blocks, constraint blocks and value types with SysML's named compartments; composition, generalization and dependency.

inside-ebike.text: A block's parts, references and values inside its frame; proxy and full ports with flow arrows and conjugation; connectors with item flows.

range-analysis.text: Constraint properties with their expressions, parameters on their borders, binding connectors to the block's value properties.

c4-context.text: The bookshop as a system among its people and external systems, on the map's card shapes.

c4-containers.text: The bookshop's containers inside its dashed boundary, each with its technology; implied relationships drawn where a view hides an end.

c4-components.text: The Shop API's components inside its boundary, with the containers and systems they talk to.

c4-placing-an-order.text: A dynamic view: placing an order as numbered steps between the containers.

c4-deployment.text: Deployment nodes nested as boxes, holding the container instances that run in production.

er-schema.text: Tables and their columns as rows, related in crow's foot or IDEF1X on one geometry: a composite key, a junction table, a nullable foreign key, a self-reference.

dfd-level-1.text: Level 1 in Yourdon notation: numbered processes, data stores and external entities joined by labelled data flows; a process opens its level.

dfd-level-2-take-order.text: Level 2 of process 1, Take order: its own processes and stores, checked for balance against the flows of its parent process.

returns.text: Ten symbols, laid out down: terminators, processes, a decision with labelled exits, input/output, a predefined process, a document, a database, manual input, a delay and a connector.

order-to-shipment.text: BPMN 2.0.2's Descriptive elements: pools and lanes, tasks, a collapsed sub-process that opens its own view, events with their markers, gateways, boundary events on an activity's border, message flows between pools, data, an annotation and a group.

pick-and-pack.text: The collapsed sub-process Pick and pack, opened as its own view: its tasks and events between its start and end.

mm-plan.text: A tree of topics laid out left and right of its root, branches as curves in the map's kind colours, edited by N, F2, Alt + arrows and drops; Mermaid mindmaps imported.

aws-on-aws.text: Accounts, regions, VPCs, availability zones, subnets and security groups as nested boxes, each service or resource a card with its icon and full service name. On this site the icons are the vendor's own, fetched with AWS's terms accepted; in a copy of this repository the diagram draws glyphs until you fetch them with `umlimator.py pack fetch aws`. Umlimator is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Google or Microsoft.

gcp-on-gcp.text: Groups nested as boxes titled with their kind, each product a card with its icon and full service name, lines to a group's border. On this site the icons are the vendor's own, fetched with Google's terms accepted; in a copy of this repository the diagram draws glyphs until you fetch them with `umlimator.py pack fetch gcp`. Umlimator is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Google or Microsoft.

az-on-azure.text: Subscriptions, resource groups, regions, virtual networks and subnets as nested boxes, each service a card with its icon and full service name. On this site the icons are the vendor's own, fetched with Microsoft's terms accepted; in a copy of this repository the diagram draws glyphs until you fetch them with `umlimator.py pack fetch azure`. Umlimator is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Google or Microsoft.
